name: 00Todo
subtitle: Tasks now, plans later
description:
00Todo keeps tasks and projects together, so you can see what is ready now without losing sight of what comes next.

Set a start date to keep future tasks out of Available until they are ready. Add a due date when something has a deadline.

Keep projects and their tasks in one list, or expand projects to see every task. A project also works as a simple shopping list.

Capture tasks by typing, speaking, or sharing text and links from other apps. On supported devices, Apple Intelligence can help turn a request into a draft.

Changes are saved on your device when you are offline and sync when you reconnect. Home Screen widgets put your available tasks close at hand.

Connect compatible assistants through MCP, then review or revoke their access in the app.

Sign in with Apple to keep your tasks in sync. No ads or subscription.
promotionalText: See what is ready now. Give future plans their own space.
